getFinanceAccounts.title: Accounts
getFinanceAccounts.subtitle: Where your money is
getFinanceAccounts.hint: The balance starts from the latest count of each account, with the movements of that same day already applied.

getFinanceAccounts.empty.text: Create an account and register the money you hold to start reconciling.

getFinanceAccounts.check.title: Counts
getFinanceAccounts.check.subtitle: Real money held in
getFinanceAccounts.check.dateHint: This is the balance at the start of that day: the expenses and income of that same date are applied on top.
